settings.label: Atlassian account email
settings.help: The account the API token belongs to.

settings.label: Jira API token
settings.help: Create at id.atlassian.com → Security → API tokens.

settings.label: JQL
settings.default: assignee = currentUser() AND statusCategory != Done ORDER BY updated DESC
settings.help: Which issues to show. Defaults to your open assigned work.

settings.label: Poll interval (s)
settings.help: How often to re-run the JQL search.

settings.label: Notify on newly assigned tickets
settings.help: OS notification when an issue enters your search that wasn't there before.

settings.label: Jira project
settings.help: This directory's Jira project key, e.g. HVMS. Set per project in Settings → Projects.

settings.label: Extra JQL
settings.help: Optional. ANDed with the base JQL for this project — for a monorepo holding two projects, or one split by component.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Jira issues with a JQL query (omit jql to use the plugin's configured default search). Returns up to maxResults issues with key, summary, status, assignee, priority, updated, and url.

jql.description: JQL query; omit for the configured default

tools.name: issue
tools.description: Fetch one Jira issue by key (e.g. HVMS-12): summary, status, description, and the most recent comments.
